title: Task Manager's audio mute icon could have a tooltip
line: Hovering the speaker icon on a task now shows a Mute or Unmute tooltip.
explanation: The audio indicator on a task is a mute button, but it had no tooltip of its own: hovering it just showed the task's window preview, so nothing said what clicking it would do. The 2022 attempt used a QQC2 ToolTip, which gets clipped inside the panel. The change puts a PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea (a real tooltip window, so nothing is clipped) over the indicator with the existing Mute/Unmute text, keeps the task's own tooltip inactive while the indicator is hovered, and hands the tooltip back to the task when the pointer moves from the indicator onto the rest of the task.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: show a tooltip on the audio indicator

Clicking the audio indicator mutes or unmutes the app, but hovering it
only showed the task's window preview, so nothing told what a click
would do. Show a Mute or Unmute tooltip over the indicator instead.

BUG: 458871

patches.diff:
From bf2068a87a66417485688a4d70a039375ff044c0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:31:58 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: show a tooltip on the audio indicator

Clicking the audio indicator mutes or unmutes the app, but hovering it
only showed the task's window preview, so nothing told what a click
would do. Show a Mute or Unmute tooltip over the indicator instead.

BUG: 458871
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/AudioStream.qml | 24 ++++++++++++++++++++++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml        |  1 +
 2 files changed, 25 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/AudioStream.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/AudioStream.qml
index bfcc47fd63..71e2c63aad 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/AudioStream.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/AudioStream.qml
@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@
 import QtQuick
 
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
+import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
 import org.kde.plasma.extras as PlasmaExtras
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg
@@ -24,6 +25,7 @@ Item {
     }
 
     readonly property real indicatorScale: 1.2
+    readonly property bool toolTipHovered: toolTipArea.enabled && toolTipArea.containsMouse
 
     activeFocusOnTab: true
 
@@ -101,6 +103,28 @@ Item {
     Accessible.description: task.muted ? i18nc("@info:tooltip %1 is the window title", "Unmute %1", model.display) : i18nc("@info:tooltip %1 is the window title", "Mute %1", model.display)
     Accessible.role: Accessible.Button
 
+    PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
+        id: toolTipArea
+
+        property bool toolTipShown: false
+
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        enabled: Plasmoid.configuration.interactiveMute
+        mainText: audioStreamIconBox.Accessible.name
+
+        onToolTipVisibleChanged: toolTipVisible => toolTipShown = toolTipVisible
+        onContainsMouseChanged: {
+            // Moving onto the rest of the task doesn't send it a new hover event, so hand it the tooltip
+            if (!containsMouse && toolTipShown) {
+                Qt.callLater(() => {
+                    if (task.containsMouse) {
+                        task.showToolTip();
+                    }
+                });
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
     HoverHandler {
         id: hoverHandler
         enabled: Plasmoid.configuration.interactiveMute
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
index 90530078c5..a528f1029e 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
@@ -80,6 +80,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
         || (!!tasksRoot.groupDialog && tasksRoot.groupDialog.visualParent === task)
 
     active: !inPopup && !tasksRoot.groupDialog && task.contextMenu?.status !== PlasmaExtras.Menu.Open && task === (tasksRoot.toolTipOpenedByClick ?? task)
+        && !audioStreamIcon?.toolTipHovered
     interactive: model.IsWindow || mainItem.playerData
     hideOnClick: !(hasAudioStream && audioIndicatorsEnabled)
     location: Plasmoid.location
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: hovering the speaker icon shows the window preview, nothing says Mute
Fix: hovering the speaker icon shows "Mute"
Master: muted app, hovering the icon still only shows the preview
Master: hovering the rest of the task shows the window preview
Fix: moving from the icon back onto the task brings the window preview back

reviews.text: Using a PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea on AudioStream.qml is the right way to avoid the panel-clipping problem from QQC2/PC3 tooltips, and the basic Mute/Unmute tooltip works in the screenshots. However, the tooltip handover back to Task.qml has two bugs: entering the badge directly from outside the panel skips task.updateMainItemBindings() because task.active is false, so moving onto the task body shows a stale preview from the previous task, and moving across the badge quickly before toolTipShown becomes true leaves the task tooltip unshown. Additionally, toolTipArea omits location: Plasmoid.location, causing the tooltip to overlap the panel/badge as seen in the after screenshots, and the Qt.callLater callback lacks safety/active guards.
changes: Call task.updateMainItemBindings() before task.showToolTip() when handing hover back from the audio badge to the task body, and handle the case where the pointer leaves the badge onto the task body before toolTipShown becomes true (so the task tooltip still opens instead of staying suppressed).
Set location: Plasmoid.location on the audio indicator's PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea so the tooltip aligns cleanly with the panel edge instead of overlapping the panel and badge.

Guard the Qt.callLater callback with `if (task && task.containsMouse && task.active)` to avoid acting on a destroyed task or showing a task tooltip when inPopup, groupDialog, or contextMenu makes task.active false, and disable toolTipArea while tasksRoot.groupDialog is open or task.contextMenu is open.

reviews.text: A PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea over the badge is the approach Nate pointed to, and since it is a real tooltip window it avoids the clipping that blocked the 2022 attempt. It reuses the existing Mute/Unmute strings, follows interactiveMute, and suppresses the task's preview tooltip only while the badge is hovered; the callLater handover back to the task is small and justified by Qt's hover delivery. Screenshots show Mute, Unmute and the preview coming back. Nitpicks: it was only tested with Icons-only Task Manager although AudioStream.qml is shared, and Task.qml reads toolTipHovered through a plain Item-typed property.
